docs.purpose: The Add lot size form of the report sheet: one number and its unit (sq ft or m²), entered once per lot (D-1 a). Declared now; it is mounted in the report sheet when the entry switch flips (the sheet is hidden while off, D-6).
docs.data_story: It posts the lot area to the entry contract, which stores one parcel_user_inputs row (source user, entered_at) that wins over the City value for every viewer; the page re-reads and shows the after-entry line.
docs.under_126: **GENERATED.** Rendered by the web FORM binding from render.form and entry_request in lot-size-entry-contract.json.

config.why: The switch, the range, the City ratio and the entries a day are logic variables read by the route.

logic_variables.name: user_lot_size_entry_enabled
logic_variables.why: Write-gating: anything but 1 inside the seed bounds reads off (D-6).

logic_variables.name: user_lot_size_min_sqm
logic_variables.why: Write-affecting (D-2): a bad value refuses the entry rather than widen it.

logic_variables.name: user_lot_size_city_ratio_max
logic_variables.why: Write-affecting (D-3); max 10 keeps the 10.76x sq ft-as-m2 slip refused (OUTPUT fold S-2).

limitations.what: The form is declared and goldened but not mounted: the report sheet is hidden while the entry switch is off (D-6), the live report is MF-44, and the report page has no Mantine provider.
limitations.measured: bindings.json mounts[] has no report_lot_size_entry row; mounting it in the sheet is a flip condition (plan v2 section 2).
